statements.status_notes: The Harbor registry 2.14 and 2.15 compiled dependency graphs include github.com/dgrijalva/jwt-go through the Azure storage driver: github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/storage imports github.com/Azure/go-autorest/autorest/adal, which imports jwt-go. CVE-2020-26160 affects audience-claim validation in dgrijalva/jwt-go v3.2.0. The abandoned dgrijalva module has no fixed release; the fix is available from the maintained github.com/golang-jwt/jwt module under a different import path. Remediation therefore requires the upstream Azure dependency chain to migrate modules and cannot be applied as a compatible version-only bump.
